decision_summary.review_model: One review is one complete rolled attempt; intermediate trail, trap, tease, jump, ferret, snare, and capture stages are simulated internally.

decision_summary.inventory: All inventory-managed skill and combat targets share one 28-slot carried model. Casual adaptive policy and advanced literal layout are persisted per target. Named advanced presets are saved/applied from a dropdown as copy-on-apply target layouts.
decision_summary.travel: Selecting a target abstracts travel to its canonical area. Enforce authentic quest gates but do not add persistent location or world-map state.
decision_summary.source_gate: Do not invent success curves, sub-rolls, damage, resource loss, perfect/tatty distribution, or bonus values before the revamped Darkan implementation is available for citation.

decision_summary.session: Use a geographically abstracted, fully simulated Runespan session with visible current-activity state; each review resolves one source-defined action in the current loop.
decision_summary.selection: Casual automatically chooses accessible targets and special opportunities. Advanced uses grouped allow-list checkboxes plus XP, points, or rune priorities and never silently overrides the checked pool.
decision_summary.lifetime: Switching away wipes temporary Runespan state and restarts from essence collection on return; closing Anki while Runespan stays selected resumes the session.
decision_summary.inventory: Runespan takes over the unified 28-slot pack with session-only essence and runes; ordinary carried items are banked on entry and temporary materials never enter the bank.
decision_summary.altar_tradeoff: Altar crafting uses an abstracted multi-review bank, travel, craft, and return cycle so Runespan remains lower-effort and slower without becoming pointless.
decision_summary.balance: Preserve exact mechanics and build historical XP-per-hour ranges for every method. Use an efficient ordinary 2012 guide route to preserve relative time-to-99 ratios under a later global compression scale.

items.title: Add the Abyss as a selectable Runecrafting route
items.detail: The Abyss is a wilderness shortcut that drops the runecrafter next to the rift ring, skipping most of the bank-to-altar walk; it is the canonical fast-but-dangerous alternative to the on-foot route for Nature and other runes. As a route (not a new rune), it applies to the existing standard/combination targets. It is the exemplar for the Agility run-energy model: its whole speed advantage is a shorter trip. Unlocked via Enter the Abyss / Abyssal mini-quest; skull and prayer-drain on entry; pouch degradation and Dark-mage repair.
items.source: wiki:Abyss (oldid 6313726); game-main RunecraftAction.kt for the craft; recon memory-bank/source-audits/runecrafting-recon-2026-07-14.md
items.note: Carded 2026-07-14 during the Agility run-energy grill (previously only loose prose in memory-bank/archive/2026-07/baselines/completion-audit.json). The Abyss-vs-foot Nature XP/hour delta is source_blocked (no period rate in any scoped page or a 400-revision scan back to 2010, per the RC recon), so the route ships as a selectable method whose throughput advantage is expressed through the sourced run-energy trip-cost model rather than a quoted rate. Familiars stay parked (Summoning dependency). See memory-bank/agility-run-energy-contract-2026-07-14.md.

items.title: Each Runecrafting method is selectable once unlocked
items.detail: Owner ruling (2026-07-14): the runecrafting method/route is a player-selectable target that becomes available the moment its unlock condition is met, rather than the game auto-picking a single method. The selectable set grows as the player unlocks it: on-foot standard/combination altars, the Abyss route (rc-abyss), Ourania/ZMI (rc-zmi-gop-wickedhood), and Runespan (rc-runespan). Method choice is Runecrafting's real throughput lever (Abyss/ZMI/Runespan/foot), which is exactly why the Agility run-energy effect on RC is small and faithful — Agility trims the walk, method changes the whole trip.
items.note: Ties the RC method cards together and anchors the Agility contract's claim that RC's speed lever is method, not Agility level. Casual mode may still surface a sensible default; Advanced exposes the full unlocked method set.

decision_summary.public_bonfire: Busy public bonfire gives the public Cooking bonus but no player Firemaking XP, warmth, or fire spirits because the player contributes no logs.

decision_summary.wilderness_control: Every source-supported skilling target gets a saved Train in Wilderness checkbox; checked means the action uses the Wilderness variant without creating a map or persistent location.
decision_summary.glove_use: Matching brawling gloves must be equipped and charged. Each XP-awarding action consumes one charge, applies the sourced Wilderness or non-Wilderness multiplier, and disintegrates the gloves at zero.
decision_summary.risk: The checked Wilderness variant uses the shared target-local carried inventory, HP, food, death, banking, and undo contracts; it never grants risk-free bonus XP.
decision_summary.scope: Use one shared cross-skill runtime for Mining, Smithing, Woodcutting, Fishing, Cooking, and Firemaking rather than six bespoke implementations.
decision_summary.source_boundary: Treat game-main values as reconstruction evidence until pinned pre-EOC evidence or high-fidelity Darkan corroborates multipliers, charges, acquisition, and Wilderness danger cadence.

items.title: Use one essence family per standard Runecrafting trip
items.detail: RunecraftAction.kt selects the first valid essence item present, counts and removes only that one item ID, and calculates output and XP from that single stack. For Air through Body runes, select exactly one essence family per action using the existing deterministic priority: Rune essence when any is available, otherwise Pure essence. Cap the trip at that selected stack plus normal capacity and never spill into the second essence family. Higher runes remain Pure-only. Preserve altar access, talismans/tiaras, pouches and degradation, multipliers, XP, outputs, and every other Runecrafting behavior. Add a mixed-stock regression where Rune essence is below capacity and Pure essence remains untouched. Do not touch Combat or Prayer.
items.note: fresh shipped-skill completeness audit pass 5, 2026-07-09

verdict.notes: Fold into main as-is. The implementation selects one stocked essence family in the established Rune-before-Pure order, caps consumption at that selected stack and normal trip capacity, and derives output and XP solely from the amount removed; Air through Body retain Rune-first behavior, while all higher standard runes remain Pure-only. The mixed-stock regression proves that a below-capacity Rune essence stack is exhausted without touching Pure essence, and the runtime carried-pack selector now uses the same priority. No Runecrafting values, altar access, talisman or tiara behavior, pouch capacity or degradation, multipliers, Combat, or Prayer behavior changed. The focused probes, 64 runtime tests, and full 983-test suite pass with 157 expected skips, git diff --check is clean, and runecrafting_data imports cleanly under /opt/homebrew/bin/python3.12; the literal requested python command exits 127 only because this host has no bare python executable.

items.title: Design Barbarian bow fire-lighting
items.detail: game-main supplies Otto dialogue, a persistent learnedBarbarianFiremaking flag, and static book instructions to use a strung bow on an oak log, but has no bound bow-on-log action consuming that unlock and no exact bow eligibility, XP distinction, or runtime mechanics. Owner must choose the training/unlock representation and approve historical source data before implementation. Do not infer values or auto-build.
items.note: bow-lighting target behavior settled from pinned oldid 6476330 on 2026-07-10; the permanent learned flag belongs to the future Barbarian Training miniquest/activity pass

decision_summary.target_shape: Do not add duplicate bow-lit log rows. Add a saved Light with bow option to existing eligible Firemaking log targets after the Barbarian Firemaking unlock.
decision_summary.casual_advanced: Casual uses the ambient/toolbelt tinderbox because bow-lighting has no source advantage; Advanced may opt into bow-lighting per target.
decision_summary.requirements: Bow-lighting requires the permanent Otto unlock, an eligible strung wooden bow, and the source's higher per-log Firemaking level; it consumes one log and awards the same XP at the same speed as ordinary lighting.
decision_summary.unlock_scope: Set learned_barbarian_firemaking through the future Barbarian Training miniquest/activity dialogue, not through a duplicate Firemaking target or an invented item unlock.

items.title: Design Cooking gauntlet conversion and burn-rate effects
items.detail: game-main defines Cooking gauntlets item 775 and its fish-cooking examine metadata but no Cooking/action plugin references it, so the exact affected foods and burn-rate mechanics are absent. Owner must approve historical source data for affected fish and thresholds and decide Family-gauntlet conversion/acquisition, equipment state, UI, persistence, undo, and review-loop behavior. Do not invent the missing values or auto-build.
items.note: conversion, equipment, Casual/Advanced, recovery, persistence, and undo design settled 2026-07-10; exact affected-fish set and intermediate burn curves wait for reconciliation of conflicting pinned period pages and high-fidelity Darkan

decision_summary.conversion: After Family Crest, manually convert Family gauntlets to Cooking gauntlets for free; changing from another enchantment costs 25,000 Coins. This NPC/item interaction consumes no review.
decision_summary.equipment: Cooking gauntlets modify existing fish-cooking targets. Casual auto-equips an owned available pair when beneficial; Advanced follows the target's saved equipment selection.
decision_summary.effect: When equipped, apply the reconciled period burn-rate reduction and zero-burn thresholds automatically; the gauntlets have no charges and never change Cooking XP.
decision_summary.recovery: Persist the selected Family-gauntlet enchantment separately so a lost pair can be reclaimed manually from Dimintheis for free with the same enchantment.
decision_summary.source_boundary: Pinned oldids disagree on whether tuna/all fish or only a narrower high-value fish set is affected, and provide thresholds rather than authoritative intermediate odds. Wait for reconciled evidence instead of inventing a formula.
